# BrandForge Media

> BrandForge Media is an independent digital studio based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. It designs and builds websites and landing pages with admin panels (from ₹18,000), custom Shopify stores (from ₹38,000), immersive 3D websites, business automation and AI assistants, social media content (packages from ₹22,000, one-time) and SEO, for businesses in Dehradun, across Uttarakhand and India.

Contact: brandforgemediaa@gmail.com · WhatsApp +91 93112 67085

## Services
- [Website design & landing pages](https://brandforge-media.vercel.app/services/website-design.html): custom sites with an admin panel, from ₹18,000
- [Shopify stores](https://brandforge-media.vercel.app/services/shopify-store-design.html): custom Shopify and Shopify Plus stores, from ₹38,000
- [3D web design](https://brandforge-media.vercel.app/services/3d-web-design.html): WebGL / Three.js websites and 3D product views
- [Business automation](https://brandforge-media.vercel.app/services/business-automation.html): lead routing, CRM sync, AI assistants
- [Social media content](https://brandforge-media.vercel.app/services/social-media-content.html): packages from ₹22,000, one-time
- [SEO services](https://brandforge-media.vercel.app/services/seo-services.html): technical, local and content SEO
